package.name: ros2_mcp_tools
package.description: ROS2 graph introspection tools (MCP server + standalone CLI) for AI assistants, plus multirobot_lint: a static analyzer for known ROS2 multi-robot pitfalls (sim-vs-real timeout assumptions, ignored anomaly flags, unreferenced safety margins, missing shutdown zero-velocity publish, etc). multirobot_lint requires no rclpy/sourced ROS2 environment and is wired into `colcon test` via test/test_multirobot_lint_self.py.
